lanes.summary: The diff correctly implements the `make gate` command as requested by the ticket, but it also adds an unrelated roadmap item (`PMAT-1386`), which violates the refutation doctrine 'default to FAIL ... when the change does something the ticket does not ask for'.

findings.claim: The diff introduces a new roadmap task `PMAT-1386`, which does something the ticket (PMAT-1365) does not ask for.

lanes.summary: The diff fully satisfies ticket PMAT-1365. It implements `make gate` backed by `scripts/gate.sh`, dynamically runs CI workflow steps directly from Actions definitions, reports all unmeasured CI-only rows on both green and red exits, validates falsification behavior across 11 arms in `scripts/gate-control.sh` (measured: exit 0), validates contract obligations with pv (measured: valid), and passes all 5 unit tests in `src/make_gate_tests.rs` (measured: ok 5/5). Foreign lifecycle row PMAT-1386 is documented and verified. No refuting evidence was found.

findings.claim: Makefile declares a .PHONY `gate:` target running `@bash scripts/gate.sh`, preventing discovery fallback to `cargo test --workspace`.

`scripts/gate.sh` maps and accounts for all 6 required CI status contexts (`gate`, `ci / gate`, `docs build (docs.rs environment)`, `feature-gate`, `pmat score`, `provable ladder`), refusing unaccounted contexts, reasonless CI-only rows, or vacuous tables with exit code 2.

`scripts/gate.sh` extracts workflow `run:` step scripts dynamically at runtime using Python and PyYAML, ensuring local execution does not drift from CI definitions and rejecting steps with Actions-only features.

`scripts/gate-control.sh` executes 11 falsification arms asserting failure behavior on missing contexts, deleted/altered workflow steps, GitHub Actions syntax dependencies, and vacuous tables. Measured: all 11 arms passed as expected.

`src/make_gate_tests.rs` defines 5 unit tests verifying Makefile target declaration, required context coverage, workflow step parsing, and disallowing invalid CI-only cost/credential exemptions. Measured: `cargo test --lib make_gate_tests` passed 5/5.
`contracts/make-gate-v1.yaml` formally specifies the properties and proof obligations for `make gate`. Measured: `pv validate contracts/make-gate-v1.yaml` reported 0 errors and 0 warnings.
`docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml` adds `kind:code` to PMAT-1365 and registers open issue #1386 as PMAT-1386 via sanctioned writer to satisfy CB-2115 bijection without altering unrelated roadmap state.

lanes.summary: The diff fully implements ticket PMAT-1365 without weakening any gate or violating repository invariants. It establishes `make gate` as the declared quality gate via `scripts/gate.sh`, dynamically runs workflow steps directly from CI definitions, reports all unmeasured CI-only rows on both green and red exits, validates falsification behavior across 11 arms in `scripts/gate-control.sh`, and enforces contract invariants under `cargo test --lib make_gate_tests`. All 5 unit tests in `src/make_gate_tests.rs` and all 11 control arms in `scripts/gate-control.sh` pass upon execution. No refuting evidence was found.

findings.claim: Makefile declares a .PHONY `gate:` target executing `@bash scripts/gate.sh`, eliminating discovery fallback to `cargo test --workspace` for PMAT-1365.

`scripts/gate-control.sh` successfully executes 11 falsification arms verifying that failure modes (missing contexts, deleted/altered workflow steps, GitHub Actions syntax dependencies, vacuous tables) are properly detected and reported.
`cargo test --lib make_gate_tests` passes all 5 tests independently validating the declared Makefile target, workflow step parsing, context coverage, and prohibiting invalid CI-only exemptions.

`docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml` updates PMAT-1365 with label `kind:code` and carries the single open lifecycle row PMAT-1386 to maintain the CB-2115 bijection with GitHub issues, as justified in the receipt.
